description: Use this when someone asks what an investor, fund, fund family or insider owns, what it bought or sold in its latest report, or who a holder is. Give it the holder's name or the id from find_holder; optionally changes (new, increased, decreased, exited). Returns the holder's profile and 6ix page and its positions in listed companies, largest first, each with shares, value as reported, share of its holdings, change since its previous report and the date; for an insider, the companies they report at, their holding after their newest trade there, and their trades.

holder.description: A name, or the id from find_holder

name: get_holder_holdings

insider.description: For an insider: the companies they report at and their trades

title: What an investor owns
